property_summary: For any actor A, performing addToBalance() with value v always makes A's post-call balance equal to its pre-call balance plus v; the mutant that assigns userBalance[msg.sender] = msg.value breaks this when A had a non-zero pre-balance (post != pre+v).
change_summary: Replace the addition with assignment, so the sender's balance becomes exactly msg.value instead of increasing by msg.value.
